players.product: Eclipse thermal test handlers for AI processors, Neon inspection, flexible ATE and PACE analytics software

quarterly_data.signal: Cohu's 10-K says it depends on Jabil, Inc. to manufacture most of its semiconductor test systems from Jabil's facility in Malaysia, where Jabil runs dedicated semiconductor ATE manufacturing operations for Cohu in Penang. Cohu also states that in 2025 it experienced supply constraints and delays in accessing certain critical components used in its test sockets due to governmental regulatory changes.

Cohu's backlog of unfilled orders for products was $165.1 million at December 27, 2025, up from $138.0 million at December 28, 2024; backlog is generally expected to ship within the next twelve months.
